signals.platform_program: Vercel AI Gateway / TypeSafe AI Jev
signals.signal_type: EXPIRING FREE DECISION MODEL / DELAYED-PRIMARY RECOVERY
signals.changed: Jev became callable through Vercel AI Gateway using TypeSafe clients, a language-neutral HTTP API, or AI SDK. It returns typed Boolean, Choice, and Score decisions with probabilities instead of prose, and is free through September 25, 2026.
signals.free_value: All Jev requests through AI Gateway are free during the published promotion. The same calls appear in Gateway usage and observability.
signals.approximate_value: The token subsidy is unquantified. The material value is avoided waste: a validated stop/retry/escalate gate could reduce the risk of another runaway agent loop whose prior observed cost was approximately $600.
signals.cash_required: $0 through September 25, subject to an AI Gateway account and API key. Post-promotion pricing and billing safeguards were not published on the launch page.
signals.eligibility_reality_check: No startup, company, funding, incorporation, geography, domain-email, team-size, or partner gate is published. A Vercel AI Gateway account and API key are required. Card, prior-payment, and post-promotion hard-stop rules are unpublished.
signals.why_asymmetric: A cheap typed evaluator can sit between expensive agent steps and answer bounded questions such as continue or stop, retry or escalate, which model to route to, and whether a tool call needs approval. Its value comes from constraining higher-cost systems, not from replacing them.

evidence.confirmed_fact: Vercel documents the September 21 launch, free-through-September-25 window, HTTP/TypeSafe/AI SDK access, Boolean/Choice/Score responses, probabilities, usage visibility, and use in eve for model selection, evaluation, and tool approvals.
evidence.inference: A calibrated Jev gate could reduce needless continuation, retries, and expensive-model calls in B2ROOT and other autonomous workflows.
evidence.unverified_claim: No evidence yet shows that Jev makes sufficiently accurate stop decisions on the user's trajectories or would have prevented the prior approximately $600 loop.

signals.catch: Typed output guarantees shape, not semantic correctness. Jev is text-only, produces no explanation, and can confidently choose the wrong action. Application code must own policy, hard spend caps, retry ceilings, side-effect permissions, and human review.
signals.window: Free through September 25, 2026; exact cutoff time and post-promotion economics are unpublished.
signals.immediate_exploit: Run 20 labeled historical or synthetic agent states through three questions: continue/stop, retry/escalate, and cheap/expensive-model route. Measure false-continue, false-stop, calibration, latency, and cost. Keep deterministic budget and retry caps authoritative.

program_surface_results: No new startup, founder, builder, accelerator, cloud-credit, grant, hackathon, research-preview, or partner-benefit program suitable for a bootstrapped solo builder survived primary-source verification.

The 60–90 day lookback recovered NVIDIA Personal AI Router as free open-source local inference routing, but the current Intel UHD 620 machine lacks a compatible accelerator, so it is not immediate leverage.

The Devin benchmark exposed a vocabulary gap: model-release scans must also search for decision models, evaluation, stop conditions, retry/escalation, model routing, and tool approval. Those terms have been added for future scans.
